runtime.source: CLAUDE_EFFORT=high, session model Opus 5.5; plan.py start --actor claude-code/claude-opus-5-5/high

runs_mode: Owner-Fast-Only (validation-and-execution-policy#Owner-Fast-Only) + owner message 2026-10-10 «сам длинные прогоны не запускай»: only targeted SQLite Pest files, Arch/golden, Pint on changed files, PHPStan of touched packages, opus-coverage/plan check. V4–V6 (PG/MySQL), V90 phase barrier V901–V928 and full package suites are NOT executed here — recorded kind=impact «не исполнено, фазовый прогон». Review: owner requested grok/grok-4.7 read-only review without mutators and long runs. No mutation tools.
risk_class: concurrency (seq order = commit order, prune ‖ read) + data-integrity (no silent loss of changes, compaction D59/D61) + access-boundary (projection of invisible nodes, cursor forgery) + schema/migration (new tables, backfill of heads) + public API (DriveHandle::changes, DTOs, enums, exceptions, config, envelope changes.seq)
decisions: D50, D59, D61 (compaction strengthened, owner choice A in this session)

core_src: Events/{EventRecorder,DomainEvent}.php (journal sink between activity and outbox; DomainEvent::journal())
drive_src: Events/{Nodes,Files}/*.php journal() for folder.created, file.uploaded, file.revision_added, node.renamed/moved/copied/updated/trashed/restored
tests: core/tests/Concurrency/ChangeJournalRaceTest.php (new, PG/MySQL; skipped on SQLite) -> phase run
core/tests/Arch/PublicApiSnapshotTest golden (+ drive/documents snapshots if their surface changes)
core/tests/Schema/* if a schema test pins the table list

callers_checked: EventRecorder::record is the only writer of journal rows (P5-invariants Bypass); EventEnvelope::fromEvent already takes ?int $changeSeq (P5.1 seam). Actions recording journalled events must call record() after their last lock (J last): checked by reading each Action that records a journalled type.
behaviour: append: duplicate change_id -> null; UPDATE head last_seq+1 (J), missing head -> insertOnce + retry; seq read in the same transaction; compaction per D59 step 3 with D61; INSERT row.
Envelope changes.seq = journal seq of the occurrence when journalled, else null.

list(): FOR SHARE head inside a transaction, else post-check of head after read; epoch/pruned_through mismatch -> 410 cursor_expired; tampered/foreign cursor -> 400 invalid_cursor; projection remove->deleted, visible upsert -> snapshot, invisible upsert -> moved_out / permission_lost / skip.
prune: per drive, batches of 1000 under head lockForUpdate, pruned_through raised in the same transaction; reset: epoch+1.

commands.targeted_core: cwd . : env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci packages/core/tests/Changes <changed core test files>
commands.targeted_drive: cwd packages/drive : env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Changes <changed drive test files>
commands.targeted_documents: cwd packages/documents : env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Events/DocumentJournalTest.php

negative_controls.b: drop the head post-check -> ChangeFeedReadTest (f) red
negative_controls.c: return the snapshot of an invisible node -> ChangeFeedReadTest (b) red

deferred_to_phase_run: P5.5 V4 (PG race/upgrade/Changes), V5 (MySQL Changes + race), V6 (PG drive Changes + lock-order races), V90 = V901–V928, plus the earlier P5 deferred H-checks (P5.1 V5, P5.2 V5–V7, P5.3 V2–V4, P5.4 V2–V4)
